history.subtitle: Our History
history.p1: MPS Machinery was born with a clear purpose: to ensure that Mozambican industries do not suffer from downtime. We know that in the heavy machinery and dredging sector, every minute stopped means significant financial loss.
history.p2: That's how we built a vast network of global suppliers, bringing genuine parts and qualified support for major global brands to Mozambique. Today, we are proud to be the right arm of the largest mining, port, and construction operations in the country.

faq.subtitle: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.desc: Hover over the cards to reveal answers about our delivery methods and warranty.
faq.q1: What is the average delivery time for wear parts?
faq.a1: For parts in local stock, delivery takes 24h to 48h. For urgent imports (Air Freight), it takes 7 to 14 days.
faq.a2: Yes, we work directly with global manufacturers ensuring all parts are original or top-tier with attested OEM quality.
faq.q3: Does MPS Machinery install the parts?
faq.a3: We offer technical supervision and consulting during installation for critical parts like hydraulic systems and engines, under contract.
faq.a4: We have national coverage. We send parts to any mine or port in Mozambique, from Maputo to Cabo Delgado, via road or air transport.
faq.q5: How to activate a component's warranty?
faq.a5: Just contact your account manager sending the part's serial number and evidence of premature failure to start the analysis process.
faq.q6: Do you have parts for small dredges?
faq.a6: Yes, we supply components from small mechanical and amphibious dredges to large Cutter Suction Dredgers (CSD).

header.desc: We offer technical support, spare parts, and specialized consulting for capital and maintenance dredging fleets. We keep Mozambican ports operational.

table.desc: Select the ideal equipment for your maritime operation based on soil characteristics and project requirements.

steps.desc: A systematic approach to ensure efficiency, safety, and environmental compliance at every step.

step1.title: 1. Bathymetric Survey
step1.desc: Detailed mapping of the sea or river bottom using advanced sonar technology to determine the exact volume of sediments to remove.

step2.title: 2. Dredging Execution
step2.desc: Mobilization of the ideal dredger and start of sediment extraction, with constant monitoring of GPS coordinates and material flow.

step3.title: 3. Validation and Safety
step3.desc: Post-dredging bathymetry to certify that project levels were reached, ensuring safe draft and technical documentation.

gallery.title: Our Work
gallery.desc: Images of dredging operations carried out with equipment supplied and supported by our team.

faq.title: Frequently Asked
faq.q1: What are the main dredging challenges in Mozambique?
faq.a1: Tidal variations and the type of coastal soil require dredgers with high cutting capacity and rapid adaptation to sea conditions.
faq.q2: How do you ensure environmental safety during operations?
faq.a2: We use sediment containment barriers and continuous turbidity monitoring, operating strictly within Mozambican environmental standards.
faq.q3: Do you supply parts for all brands of dredgers?
faq.a3: Yes, we work with original and aftermarket parts (OEM) for the main global manufacturers of CSD, TSHD, and mechanical dredgers.
faq.q4: What is the difference between capital and maintenance dredging?
faq.a4: Capital dredging creates new channels or significantly deepens existing ones, requiring heavy equipment for hard soil. Maintenance dredging removes recent sediments (sand/mud) to keep navigable depth.
